rotating_tips: Message with @name or #group — tap a chat header to focus a target
@bot — PointChat AI in your notes thread
@bot new AssistantName — custom bot; @bot create Long Name — multi-word name
/location — share your position (slash menu or type after @target)
/setting @user or #group — open settings for that conversation
Voice notes: tap −1s / +1s or swipe the waveform to seek
Tip: type @ to see people, commands, and @bot
ai_knowledge: PointChat is a chat app with direct messages (@username), groups (#groupname), voice messages, photo/file attachments, and location sharing via /location. @bot sends a private message to PointChat AI in the user's self-chat thread. @bot new Name or @bot create Long Name opens the flow to create a custom bot DM with custom instructions; @makebot Name is a legacy alias for @bot new. Do not use @bot make for bot creation (that phrase is treated as normal AI chat). @ai behaves like @bot. Custom bots reply automatically when messaged. Slash commands include /myprofile, /setting, /location. Users need a selected @ or # target for most sends unless a conversation is focused.
